title: SF bridge, cable car and museums

turns.prompt: Plan a guided San Francisco day on October 17, 2026, 9am–5pm America/Los_Angeles. I want the Golden Gate Bridge, a cable car ride, SFMOMA and the de Young. Use this supplied planning fixture, not live claims: Bridge 37.8199,-122.4783, 60 minutes; Powell/Market cable-car boarding 37.7847,-122.4079, 30 minutes including the ride; SFMOMA 37.7857,-122.4011, 60 minutes; de Young 37.7715,-122.4687, 60 minutes. Both museums are available 10am–4pm in this fixture. In that order allow 40, 20 and 35 minutes between stops, valid on that date. I want to adjust the plan here, see the stops on a map and download the current calendar. Clearly label supplied estimates; don't look up or book anything.
criteria: Interactive itinerary with all four supplied places and museum constraints
305 minutes including directed transfers; fits available window
No invented bookings or live opening-hour claims
Calendar and map refer to same itinerary; stable viewId
